newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African June gold/forex reserves 22.1 bln rand.
newsitem.headline: S.African June gold/forex reserves 22.1 bln rand.

text.p: South Africa's combined gold and foreign exchange reserves rose 0.3 billion rand in June to 22.1 billion rand from May's 21.8 billion rand, the Reserve Bank said on Tuesday.
It gave only a preliminary headline figure, adding a full breakdown would be published next Monday.
Analysts polled by Reuters had predicted combined reserves of 23.0 to 28.0 billion rand, with the consensus at 24.68 billion.

The central bank said that its utilisation of foreign credit lines at the end of June 1997 was unchanged at 1.8 billion rand, while the proceeds of government's Samurai Bond issue of 40 billion yen, or 1.57 billion rand, accrued to the reserves in the month.
It said "identifiable outflows" for the quarter-end were in excess of 2.2 billion rand. This amount included the second instalment of the IMF Compensatory Financing Facility of 465.4 million rand.
The proceeds of the Yankee bond issue of $500 million (2.2 billion rand) were not included in the figure, it added.
